name: The Flaming Feather
description: Toverland's finest dining experience — a beautifully themed medieval inn nestled in the heart of Avalon offering full table service and an impressive a la carte menu of Burgundian meat and fish dishes, vegetarian options and seasonal specials. With crackling fireplaces, long wooden tables and warm candlelight, The Flaming Feather feels like genuine medieval hospitality and is completely unlike a typical theme park restaurant. With 130 seats across an impressive indoor dining hall and outdoor terraces, this is the place for a proper sit-down meal between adventures.

name: Katara Plaza
description: A vibrant outdoor food court in the Magische Vallei area with an exotic terrace overlooking the spectacular Katara water show. Katara Plaza serves tropical-inspired dishes, snacks and refreshing drinks in a colourful open-air setting that is one of the liveliest dining spots in the park. The combination of good food and the dramatic Katara water show backdrop makes this a memorable lunch or dinner stop especially on sunny days.

name: Waldstube
description: A cosy food court nestled in the Wunderwald forest area serving freshly made Italian pizzas, burgers and sandwiches in a warm woodland lodge atmosphere. Waldstube is one of the most popular quick-service dining spots in the park thanks to its freshly prepared food and welcoming forest setting. The wood-panelled interior with forest theming makes it feel like a genuine woodland retreat rather than a standard theme park canteen.

name: Hungry Harry
description: A popular takeaway in the Avalon area offering tasty sandwiches, wraps, pulled pork burgers and crispy fries alongside sweet treats including soft ice cream, milkshakes and cotton candy. Hungry Harry is the perfect quick stop between rides in the Avalon area, with fast service and a wide variety of grab-and-go options. Its location near Fenix and Troy makes it one of the most visited food stops in the park.
